messages:
Mia Chen: quick sync — finalizing benchmark narrative for launch. Need 3 snackable cards + 2 micro-charts: tokens->$ (unit econ) and latency vs cost buckets. Want the story readable in one glance and clicks routed to the right nurture.

Samir Patel: cards: hero stat (unit cost), tiny sparkline for tokens->$, single-line CTA. Make alt text mandatory.

Olivia Gomez: slices: chat-short (<=128), chat-long (512+), embeddings. Tag deployment type (hosted / dedicated / private) as a small pill.

Jasper Li: tokens->$ chart: x [100,1k,10k,100k], two series: mean and p90. Annotate batching + KV cache effect (30-60% gap).

Priya Raman: latency vs cost buckets: buckets = ["<50ms","50-150ms","150-400ms","400ms+"], y=median $ per 1k tokens, color by deployment. Add dashed cold-cache fallback line.

Samir Patel: chart config to hand to eng (text):
```
chart_type: latency_cost_buckets
x: latency_bucket
y: median_cost_per_1k
series: deployment_type
buckets: ["<50ms","50-150ms","150-400ms","400ms+"]
annotations: ["cache_effect","auto_batching"]
```

Olivia Gomez: copy tones — dev/platform/exec. Short drafts: dev: "Ship LLM features that don’t surprise you — predictable latency, predictable cost." platform: "One API, multiple deployment profiles. Compare latency and unit cost." exec: "Lower inference spend while meeting latency targets."

Mia Chen: social header options: A) "Benchmarks that map tokens to dollars and ms to SLA risk." B) "Compare latency and unit cost across deployment options." Lean B. Subhead: "Hosted, Dedicated, Private — same API, different economics."

Samir Patel: primary CTA = webinar signup (launch focus). Secondary = try the benchmark runner. Tertiary = request dedicated eval.

Priya Raman: inbound routing mapping: utm_campaign=bench_launch&utm_medium=social&utm_content={creative}. Map: tokens_chart -> pricing-nurture, latency_chart -> reliability-nurture, card_cta_webinar -> webinar-nurture. I’ll add short nurture preview copy.

Jasper Li: design asks: visible axis units (ms and USD / 1k tokens), clear legend, tiny accessibility text. Also request a tiny mobile-first variant (vertical stack).

Mia Chen: timeline: design comps Tue, copy Wed AM, assets live Fri. Webinar tentative per marketing-bot — confirm today. Next actions: Samir finalize CSVs + chart JSON, Olivia post three caption drafts here, Priya finalize routing + UTMs, Design deliver comps.

marketing-bot: Webinar slot tentative: 2026-04-09 09:00 PDT — please confirm by EOD.

Samir Patel: confirmed.

Olivia Gomez: confirmed.

Jasper Li: confirmed.

Mia Chen: thanks team — check-in Wed AM. :rocket: (react :thumbsup:)
